{{samename|volumes published in {{pmin|France}} by Kurokawa|List of Pokémon Black and White volumes (France)}}
Beginning in July 2011, [[VIZ Media]] began releasing volumes of the {{MangaArc|Black & White}} of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga created by [[Hidenori Kusaka]] and [[Satoshi Yamamoto]], using the title "Pokémon Black and White" and advertised as a "Pokémon Adventures special edition". As the chapters of the {{MangaArc|Black & White}} had not yet begun release in [[List of Pokémon Adventures volumes|collected volume format]] in Japan, these releases are compiled directly from the original magazine publication of Pokémon Adventures. As a result, any changes that were made for the volume version are subsequently absent. VIZ Media later began releasing {{PAV|43}} and onward, allowing readers the choice between the magazine and volume version of the manga, as in Japan. This is a list of these "Pokémon Black and White" volumes which were published with eight volumes before VIZ took a break for nearly a year, before beginning publication again with releasing the twelve remaining volumes until the twentieth and final volume was published in February 2015. This particular series of volumes has also been translated into {{pmin|Italy|Italian}}.
